name: IOF Biopharma
description: The Biopharma reference ontology of the Industrial Ontologies Foundry (IOF), developed by the IOF under the Open Applications Group (https://spec.industrialontologies.org) and licensed under MIT, from Release 202603: the thirteen modules the release lists at production maturity. They describe the manufacture of biopharmaceuticals: materials such as culture media, buffers, cell lines and drug substances, and the molecular entities they're made of; bioreactors, chromatography systems and other equipment, organized into the ISA-88 and ISA-95 physical hierarchy of sites, areas, process cells, units and modules; general, master and control recipes; the upstream, downstream and fill-finish processes that execute them; process parameters, quality attributes and the targets, limits and ranges that bound them; monitoring, sampling and control; and material procurement and storage. Built on IOF Core and the Basic Formal Ontology (BFO 2020), with Supply Chain and Certification, which the closure of their owl:imports adds; of those, the classes Biopharma extends, points at or requires are kept. Each class is a node, each object property a relationship from its domain to its range (one direction per inverse pair), each datatype property a property, each class restriction a count, and each superclass an implied label.
